- [AllergyIntolerance](https://developer.healthgorilla.com/reference/allergyintolerance-1.md)
- [Read](https://developer.healthgorilla.com/reference/read-10.md): Retrieve a single AllergyIntolerance resource by its FHIR ID.
- [Search](https://developer.healthgorilla.com/reference/search-10.md): Search for `AllergyIntolerance` resources matching the specified criteria.
- [Create](https://developer.healthgorilla.com/reference/create-7.md): Create a new AllergyIntolerance resource.
- [Update](https://developer.healthgorilla.com/reference/update-5.md): Replaces an existing AllergyIntolerance resource by full resource replacement.
- [Delete](https://developer.healthgorilla.com/reference/delete-3.md): Delete an existing AllergyIntolerance resource by FHIR ID.
